_note: PLACEHOLDER general skill tree for the Lords & Heroes window (game-design §4.4: one point per level, career trees with rows by function; example General branches Command / Logistics / Conquest). Names, levels and texts are placeholders; the skills have no gameplay effect until the character system is built (game-design §4.4, build order 6). Each row is read left to right: a skill needs the one before it in its row and the character level shown. auto_order is the row order auto-allocation fills (round robin).
